title: A timeline changes the text of a node
body: A timeline changes a node's position, size, opacity and colors, but not its text. `figures/sufr-build.acre` shows every value that changes, such as an LCP placeholder 0 that becomes 4, as a second node faded in over the first. The proposal is an action such as `text NAME "4"` at an instant, and `text ROW N "4"` for one cell of a row.
